versions.subject: Add Files Dropped to Program Files by Non-Priviledged Process Rule
versions.detection:
integrity:
    IntegrityLevel: 'Medium'
program_files:
    - TargetFilename|contains:
        - '\Program Files\'
        - '\Program Files (x86)\'
    - TargetFilename|startswith: '\Windows\'
temp:
    TargetFilename|contains: 'temp'
condition: integrity and (program_files or temp)
versions.spl: IntegrityLevel="Medium" TargetFilename IN ("*\\Program Files\\*", "*\\Program Files (x86)\\*") OR TargetFilename="\\Windows\\*" OR TargetFilename="*temp*"
